prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1195; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd prefer to leave my name off the recording, if that's okay. I'm the driver of the blue sedan.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the collision happened?
A: It was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Katy, Texas. I was pulling out of a space near the main entrance.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I had checked my mirrors and started backing out slowly. I hadn't gone more than a couple of feet when a pickup came around the row and hit the rear quarter panel of my car.
Q: Was the other vehicle moving quickly?
A: It didn't look fast to me, but it was coming through the lane faster than people usually drive in there.
Q: Did you notice any warning signs or pavement markings in that row?
A: There's a stop sign at the end of the row, but I couldn't see whether the other driver stopped. My view was partly blocked by a parked van.
Q: How are you feeling now?
A: Not great. I hit my head on the steering wheel and the side window. I've had headaches, sensitivity to light, and I get foggy when I read for long periods.
Q: Have you seen a doctor about that?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day and I've been referred to a neurologist. I'm keeping a log of my symptoms.
Q: Did you lose consciousness at any point?
A: I don't think so, but I was dazed for a little while, and I don't remember the minutes right after the impact.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I want my car repaired and my medical bills taken care of. I'll send the paperwork over.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
